claims.claim: The Bank of Israel new-series-database (Fusion Edge Server) serves data over SDMX 2.1 REST at https://edge.boi.gov.il/FusionEdgeServer/ws/public/sdmxapi/rest/data/{DATAFLOW}/{series} . The older sdmx/v2/data/dataflow/BOI/... path returns 404. Requests need a normal browser User-Agent and use startPeriod/endPeriod; observations come back as <Obs TIME_PERIOD OBS_VALUE> elements. The structure/metadata path is https://edge.boi.gov.il/FusionEdgeServer/sdmx/v2/structure/dataflow/BOI.STATISTICS .
claims.verified_via: cited page fetched and confirmed to contain "404"; snippet replaced with the page's own wording around it

claims.claim: Representative exchange rates (sha'ar yatzig) are per-currency series named RER_<CUR>_ILS inside the BOI.STATISTICS EXR dataflow, and DATA_TYPE OF00 marks the official representative rate. Verified live on 2026-08-11: RER_USD_ILS ran 3.059 (3 Aug 2026) to 2.998 (10 Aug 2026); RER_EUR_ILS and RER_JPY_ILS (UNIT_MULT 2, i.e. per 100 JPY) resolve on the same endpoint.

claims.claim: Bank of Israel interest-rate data is in the BIR dataflow; CPI / price indices are in the PRI dataflow. Both are reachable via the same REST data path. The headline policy rate is most reliably read from the Monetary Committee decision (boi.org.il monetary-policy / press releases). The committee announces rate decisions about 6 times per year.
claims.raw_snippet: The Bank of Israel Monetary Committee sets the interest rate and announces decisions on scheduled dates (about six times a year); rate and price-index series are published in the new series database (BIR, PRI dataflows).

claims.claim: The BOI representative exchange rate is published once per business day: Monday-Thursday at approximately 15:30, Friday at approximately 12:30 Israel time; no publication on Saturday or Sunday, because the Israeli financial week moved to Monday-Friday effective 5 January 2026 (Sunday dropped as a publication day, Friday added). CBS publishes CPI around the 15th of the following month. The BOI inflation target is 1-3%.
claims.raw_snippet: representative rate determined from transactions published each business day Monday-Friday afternoon around 15:30 Friday 12:30 not published Saturday Sunday holidays inflation target 1% 3%
